title: GPUs: only through the queue, from the right capacity, scaled from zero
design_ref: Inside a GPU cluster; Autoscaling: where capacity comes from; Multi-tenant isolation (side doors)
purpose: Run GPU jobs through the hub, check which kind of capacity each team's job got, check that the GPU nodes appear only when needed and disappear when idle, and try to get a GPU without going through the queue.

checks.description: there is no GPU instance before any job is submitted
the first llm job got on-demand GPU capacity (the first flavor in its queue)
checks.because: A job tries the flavors of its queue in order and takes the first with room.

checks.description: the second llm job, with the on-demand share used up, got Spot
checks.because: llm owns one on-demand and one Spot GPU. The second job falls through to the next flavor.

checks.description: the research job got Spot, the only flavor its queue lists
checks.because: Research's queue does not include on-demand, so an experiment can never buy it.

checks.description: GPU nodes were created, from a GPU instance family the pool allows, in the pools that match the flavors
checks.because: The flavor's node label selects the NodePool, so quota and capacity line up.

checks.description: the job saw a real GPU
checks.because: The device plugin gave the pod one GPU, and nvidia-smi inside it names the device.

checks.description: a GPU pod with no queue label is held by a scheduling gate and never runs
checks.because: Kueue manages every pod in a team namespace. Without a queue it adds a scheduling gate that nothing removes.

checks.description: a GPU pod outside the queues stays Pending, and no node was bought for it
checks.because: GPU nodes are tainted. The pod has no toleration, and the built-in pool has no GPU instance types, so nothing can satisfy it.

checks.description: every GPU instance was terminated after the jobs ended (scale to zero)
checks.because: The NodePool removes empty nodes two minutes after the last pod leaves, and Auto Mode terminates the instance.

notes: Waiting for the GPU nodes to be removed once they are empty.
